components.gap: Not every claimed theorem of Barwise ch. A.1 has a complete written proof on the handbook route. Missing, per the proofboundary records at owned body lines 1669-1704 and 2169-2197: (1) p.16, the theory of abelian groups is decidable (Szmielew): no effective reduction of sentences of {+,0} to Boolean combinations of invariant sentences and no proof that it preserves truth in every abelian group; (2) p.16, the theory of groups is undecidable: no interpretation of an essentially undecidable theory in a finitely axiomatized group theory and no transfer proof (the transfer is the cited thm:p05-interpretation-transfer, cited=TMR1953); (3) p.44, the least logic containing weak second-order logic in which implicit definitions become explicit (Barwise 1974 Part II Thm 4.1, Delta(L^w)=Delta(L(Q0))=L_HYP): the construction of Delta(L*), interpolation for L_HYP, the admissible-set facts and the passage from the Souslin-Kleene property to the chapter wording are not written; (4) the chain to the p.16 claims that Z is not decidable and that Goedel-second yields a true unprovable sentence rests at one step (owned annex line 3453, part 3 of thm:p02-w02c-p02-003-sharp-enumeration) on thm:p04-tm-partial-recursive, which is cited=Kleene1952, not proved. In addition, 5.7 for general languages and most Section 5 and p.16 proofs live in the owned files, which are not yet \input on the route (route pending).
